headline: Marketing and Product Builder
intro: I work in marketing, but my interests often extend into the systems, workflows and products around it.
bio: As I work on campaigns, acquisition and positioning, I often become as interested in the problems around the work as the work itself. Why is useful information scattered? Could this process be simpler? Do other people face the same problem? If something were built around it, what should it help them do? How could the journey feel intuitive, the interface stay clear, and the number of clicks be kept to a minimum?

Those questions have drawn me towards product thinking. I have started exploring how better workflows, internal systems and digital products can solve recurring problems rather than simply working around them.

My work now sits somewhere between marketing, product and execution. I like understanding how the different parts fit together, shaping the experience around the user, and turning an idea into something practical that people can actually use.

experience.role: Demand Generation Associate & Forward Deployed Specialist
experience.summary: Demand generation, account-based marketing, outreach automation and internal software utilities. I also pitched and delivered four projects beyond my core role, moving into workflow design and AI-assisted product building.

B2B marketing, market research, lead generation, ABM, qualification and nurturing. Rebuilt parts of the funnel, contributing to a reported 2× increase in campaign response rates and roughly 120% better paid-media performance.
Go-to-market strategy, positioning and messaging for four products across India, the UAE, Africa and North America, through to launch planning and customer-facing assets.
Integrated campaigns, paid media, targeting, creative testing and conversion journeys, associated with a 130% increase in customer onboarding and roughly 30% lower acquisition cost.
Market research, lead generation, nurturing and conversion for financial-sector accounts. It moved me closer to commercial conversations and changed how I understood attention, intent and timing.
Content creation, campaign ideation, offline marketing and user onboarding: an operational introduction to how campaigns, communication and customer experience connect.
